text.zh: 晉嘉科技（香港）有限公司

連接科技，
推動業務。
以專業連接科技，以創新推動業務
從日常 IT 營運到企業數碼轉型，為每一個業務挑戰，找到合適的解決方案。
text.en: From everyday IT operations to digital transformation, we connect your business with the right solutions.

text.zh: 連接設備、數據與工作流程
整合現有系統與科技設備，建立更流暢、靈活的業務環境，讓團隊協作更有效率。
text.en: Bring systems and technology together to create a coherent, flexible business environment and smoother collaboration.

text.zh: 由日常營運，到下一個發展階段
從 IT 支援、基礎設施到企業應用，與您一起建立穩健的科技基礎，面向長遠發展。
text.en: From IT support and infrastructure to business applications, build a robust technology foundation for your next chapter.

text.zh: 以香港為本，面向更廣闊的未來
text.en: Rooted in Hong Kong. Looking ahead.

text.zh:
讀懂業務。
讓科技發揮價值。
晉嘉科技於 2018 年成立。我們將專業資訊設備、系統整合及工程服務連接起來，為企業建立穩健而靈活的科技基礎。
text.en: Established in 2018, RS Technologies brings together professional IT equipment, systems integration and engineering to build a resilient, flexible foundation for business.

text.zh: 2025 年，我們成立進嘉科技（深圳）有限公司，將服務拓展至大灣區，與客戶一起邁向下一階段。
text.en: In 2025, we established RS Technology (Shenzhen) Limited, expanding our presence in the Greater Bay Area alongside our clients.

text.zh: 專業，體現在每一個細節

以專業標準，
建立信任。

從資訊安全、環境責任到品質管理，
以清晰的管理標準，支持長遠的合作。
text.en: From information security and environmental responsibility to quality management, clear standards support lasting partnerships.

text.zh: 以資訊安全管理為基礎，重視企業資訊與業務資料的保護。
text.en: A management framework focused on protecting business information and data.

text.zh: 將環境管理融入日常營運，持續關注資源使用與環境影響。
text.en: Bringing environmental management into daily operations, resource use and environmental impact.

text.zh: 以品質管理規範服務流程，重視一致的交付與持續改善。
text.en: A quality management framework supporting consistent processes and continual improvement.

text.en: From devices to systems, infrastructure to applications. Five areas of expertise, built around your needs.

text.zh: 不確定從哪裡開始？讓我們先了解您的業務。
text.en: Not sure where to begin? Let's start with your business.

text.en: Connect data, teams and workflows with the Hyper Application Platform. Build business applications and simplify repetitive work with no-code development and automation.

讓可持續發展，成為日常的一部分。
text.en: We care about business growth, and how we achieve it. Making sustainability part of the everyday.

text.en: Bringing together technology expertise for your business.

desc: 從日常技術支援到雲端及本地系統管理，透過高效的工單流程，協助團隊處理技術問題，專注核心業務。
From daily technical support to cloud and on-premises management, our ticket-based support helps your team resolve issues and focus on core business.
連接設備、軟件及現有系統，整理分散的資訊與工作流程，建立更流暢、可擴展的業務環境。
Connect devices, software and existing systems to bring fragmented information and workflows into a more coherent, scalable business environment.
從網絡設計、伺服器優化到虛擬化部署，建立穩健的 IT 基礎，配合企業營運與未來擴展需要。
Build a robust IT foundation with network design, server optimization and virtualization, supporting your operations and future expansion.
整合閉路電視、門禁控制與 AI 安全技術，按照實際場景設計合適的防護方案，守護人員與資產。
Combine CCTV, access control and AI-powered security technology in solutions tailored to your environment, protecting people and assets.
作為 NOCOLY 授權合作夥伴，我們以 HAP 超級應用平台協助企業建立銷售、營運、人事及採購應用，透過工作流自動化及 API 整合，連接企業內外數據。

As an authorized NOCOLY partner, we help businesses build sales, operations, HR and procurement applications on HAP. Workflow automation and API integration connect data across the organization and beyond.

title: 從日常開始，讓改變發生。
Small everyday actions. Lasting change.
desc: 將綠色辦公室理念融入日常營運，從節能、減廢到負責任的採購，持續改善我們對環境的影響。
We bring green office principles into our daily operations, improving our environmental impact through energy conservation, waste reduction and responsible procurement.
items: 推進電子行政與電子採購，減少用紙

優先考慮負責任的供應商及回收渠道
Digital administration and e-procurement to reduce paper
Electronic equipment recycling and component reuse
Responsible suppliers and certified recycling channels

title: 與社群建立更長遠的連接。
Building lasting connections with our community.
desc: 晉嘉科技於 2024/25 年獲得「商界展關懷」嘉許標誌，評級為「表現高於平均水平」。我們重視企業與社會的連接，將關懷融入企業文化。
RS Technologies received the 2024/25 Caring Company Scheme recognition with above-average performance. We value our connection with society and make care part of our company culture.
